item.title: Threat Hunting: Malicious DLL Side-Loading via LinkedIn Lures
item.description:
This post will cover a real-world technique where adversaries use LinkedIn messaging to deliver malicious payloads that leverage DLL side-loading. I will describe the simulation approach, required telemetry, hunting queries, and recommended tools in the full article — coming soon.

Stay tuned for a detailed walkthrough and detection guidance.
